天安門事件はなぜ起きたのか — Reform, Repression, and Memory

Why did a country opening its economy send troops against people demanding reform? 1989年の天安門事件には学生だけでなく労働者や一般市民も関わった。This research essay checks the chronology, casualty geography, leadership conflicts, and the limits of official and diplomatic records. 守破離を通じて、economic reform and political freedom do not always move together という問いを考える。
